_comment: Claude Code project-scope MCP configuration. Save as .mcp.json at your project root and commit it to share the server with your team; secrets stay out via ${VAR} expansion, which Claude Code performs on command, args, env, url and headers. Local scope (~/.claude.json, not committed) is written for you by `claude mcp add`. The 'type' field accepts 'streamable-http' as an alias for 'http'. IMPORTANT: an entry with a 'url' but no 'type' is a configuration error — Claude Code reads a typeless entry as stdio and skips the server.

catalogue-http._comment: Bearer token read from your shell environment, so nothing secret is committed. The equivalent one-liner is: claude mcp add --transport http catalogue-http http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $MCP_AUTH_TOKEN"
